visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins with a 2D orange-striped cartoon cat positioned in the center against a stark white background. The cat has a happy expression with closed, upward-curving eyes and an open, smiling mouth. It holds its left paw up near its head. Large black text is centered in the upper third of the frame. (2) The scene jump-cuts to the same cat character in an identical pose and setting. The cat maintains its joyful facial expression with the mouth open. The black text above the character changes to a new set of characters, but the overall composition and the cat's physical posture remain completely static and unchanged from the previous phase. (3) The scene jump-cuts again, showing a significant shift in the cat's physical state. The cat now exhibits a deadpan, unimpressed facial expression with flat, horizontal lines for eyes and a small, closed horizontal line for a mouth. Its arms are now positioned straight down at its sides. The text above the cat updates to a third phrase. (4) The final scene jump-cuts to the cat showing a determined and slightly aggressive expression. Its eyebrows are furrowed downward toward the center, and its mouth is a small 'o' shape. It points its right paw directly toward the viewer in a gesturing motion. The background remains white, and the final line of text appears at the top.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 新的一年快到了. [Slogan]: The new year is coming. [Logo]: ©MOCHI DAD/THAT FISH CORP. (2) [Subtitle]: 過去的日子我罵了不少人. [Slogan]: I've scolded a lot of people this past year. (3) [Subtitle]: 我在這裡也不打算道歉. [Slogan]: And I'm not planning to apologize. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為你們是真的很欠罵. [Slogan]: Because honestly, you all really deserved it.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A solid, clean white background with no additional environmental objects or textures throughout the entire animation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, woody percussive impact sound resembling a woodblock strike opens the phase. A male voice speaks Mandarin with a clear, rhythmic cadence and a slightly playful tone. High-pitched, melodic woodwind music (recorder or flute style) plays in the background with a consistent, bouncy tempo. (2) A second identical woodblock impact sound triggers this phase. The male voice continues speaking at a moderate pace, maintaining its clarity and melodic intonation. The woodwind-driven background music remains stable in volume and rhythm, providing a cheerful acoustic bed for the narration. (3) A third woodblock impact sound marks the start of this phase. The male voice undergoes a tonal shift, becoming flatter and more deadpan in delivery, which contrasts with the previous playful energy. The woodwind BGM continues its repetitive and rhythmic pattern without any change in complexity. (4) A final woodblock impact sound occurs. The male voice delivers the final sentence with increased emphasis and a sharp, assertive finish. The background music concludes abruptly at the end of the phrase, followed by total silence. The overall mix is studio-clean with high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a popular cartoon character, Mochi Dad, to deliver a humorous and blunt New Year's message. The contrast between the cute, animated cat and the defiant text—which claims no regrets for scolding others—creates a comedic effect intended for social sharing and relatable humor during the holiday season.
